parsed.visual_overview: A young man and an AI robot sit on a beach having a conversation. The video cuts to app UI screencasts showing features and download screens while the voiceover continues.

scenes.script_native:
Rahul says: Interview में 'Myself Rahul' बोल कर intro दे सकता हूँ?
Miss Nova says: नहीं Rahul. 'Myself' से start करना wrong है. आप 'I am Rahul' या 'My name is Rahul' बोलिए.
Rahul says: अच्छा! पर मुझे तो English बोलनी आती ही नहीं है.
Miss Nova says: Tension मत लीजिए. मैं सब कुछ Hindi में समझाऊँगी.
scenes.script_roman:
Rahul says: Interview mein 'Myself Rahul' bol kar intro de sakta hoon?
Miss Nova says: Nahi Rahul. 'Myself' se start karna wrong hai. Aap 'I am Rahul' ya 'My name is Rahul' boliye.
Rahul says: Acha! Par mujhe toh English bolni aati hi nahi hai.
Miss Nova says: Tension mat lijiye. Main sab kuch Hindi mein samjhaungi.

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: मेरे साथ daily बस 10-15 minutes speaking practice कीजिए.
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: Mere saath daily bas 10-15 minutes speaking practice kijiye.

scenes.script_native:
Miss Nova says: और 30 days में आप improve करेंगे.
Rahul says: पर इसकी fees तो बहुत ज़्यादा होगी?
scenes.script_roman:
Miss Nova says: Aur 30 days mein aap improve karenge.
Rahul says: Par iski fees toh bohot zyada hogi?

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: बिल्कुल नहीं! Supernova AI offline coaching से सात गुना सस्ता है.
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: Bilkul nahi! Supernova AI offline coaching se saat guna sasta hai.

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: 1 crore+ लोग already मेरे साथ practice कर रहे हैं.
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: 1 crore+ log already mere saath practice kar rahe hain.

scenes.script_native: Rahul says: Super! मैं अभी Supernova AI download करता हूँ.
scenes.script_roman: Rahul says: Super! Main abhi Supernova AI download karta hoon.
